preconditions.description: The number of shamans N, max friends D, days U, and queries Q are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(H) == N and all(0 <= h <= 10**9 for h in H)
preconditions.description: The altitude list H contains exactly N integers, each between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(updates) == U and all(0 <= a < N and 0 <= b < N and a != b for a, b in updates)
preconditions.description: There are exactly U update pairs, each consisting of two distinct shaman indices within valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and x != y and 0 <= v <= U for x, y, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query contains distinct shaman indices x and y, and a day v within the valid range [0, U].

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == 0) or (int(output_lines[i]) == 10**9) or (0 < int(output_lines[i]) < 10**9) for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing a distance, specifically 0, 10^9, or a positive value less than 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == 10**9) if (len(get_friends_at_day(x, updates, v)) == 0 or len(get_friends_at_day(y, updates, v)) == 0) else (int(output_lines[i]) == min(abs(H[a] - H[b]) for a in get_friends_at_day(x, updates, v) for b in get_friends_at_day(y, updates, v))) for i, (x, y, v) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (x, y, v), if either x or y has no trusted friends on day v, the output is 10^9; otherwise, it is the minimum absolute difference in altitude between any friend of x and any friend of y on day v.
